scope: Independent read-only review of the final HTTP mutation Origin guard, strict configured CORS and existing loopback UI change; authored focused in-process TestClient requests only. No source edits, provider/network/listening sockets/Docker/lifespan/training/remote action.

guard_review.before_handler: Unsafe methods with any Origin field are checked before handlers and AIGA metrics/auth bypass branches. Rejection is403 with generic detail.
guard_review.syntax_and_duplicates: Exactly one header and exactly one untrimmed valid HTTP(S) origin are required; null/empty/userinfo/path/query/fragment/percent/backslash/control/comma/duplicate Origins are refused. Full authority regex closes bracket prefix/suffix and IPvFuture parser pitfalls.
guard_review.permitted_paths: Exact configured origin or actual request scheme+netloc origin is permitted; no-Origin API requests retain previous flow. Existing AIGA bearer/JWT authentication is still applied after Origin acceptance; configured origin is not authority by itself.
guard_review.cors: Default empty CORS grants retained; same-origin browser requests need no CORS grant. Configured origin matching remains exact.
guard_review.websocket_scope: Existing world-model/ws read-only stream unchanged and excluded from HTTP mutation/Origin claim.
guard_review.ui: Previously reviewed loopback default and explicit operator bind remain unchanged.

tests.command: python -m pytest --noconftest -o addopts= -q -s tests/test_legacy_http_security.py with read-only cache observer plugin
tests.requests: Actual FastAPI handlers execute only authored stub callbacks; no providers or real mutations. Direct POST tests avoid depending on browser preflight behavior.
tests.covered: Default/configured CORS; four actual mutation routes; invalid,duplicate,unrelated Origins; same-origin/configured/no-Origin successes; existing auth rejection; UI bind and test-memory access; module-cache restoration.

previous_findings.stub_cache_P2: Resolved: setitem(None) then delitem registers cleanup, prior AIGA stub module no longer remains cached; UI app test-memory module removed after test.
previous_findings.remaining_real_world_model_cache: Expected: package __init__ eagerly imports the real world-model module before the restoration test removes it. Fixture restores that original real module. It has real Orchestrator, orchNone, loop_threadNone; this is not a stub/lifespan leak.

limits: This is scoped local security review/test evidence, not public install, real browser journey, deployed service, provider, research or release qualification. Earlier failed-cache evidence and review are retained.
